company_info.company_description: "Springers Solar provides quality components with proven performance, backed by an industry-leading workmanship warranty and dedicated after-sales support. Thousands of satisfied customers over more than 20 years of operation make Springers Solar one of the most established and experienced solar companies in Australia.Springers Solar has received multiple awards for design and installation, are preferred/certified installer for several panels and inverter manufacturers, and is a Certified Premium Tesla Installer. We are trusted by Brisbane City Council, Moreton Bay Regional Council, Sunshine Coast Regional Council, and Logan City Council and are a local buy supplier for the Queensland Government.Springers Solar proudly employs full-time qualified sales, design, installation, and support staff who will work closely with you before, during, and long after the project is completed. Our dedicated in-house team includes electrical engineers, project managers, solar PV designers, electricians, and solar installers. Springers Solar offers an industry-leading 10-year workmanship warranty which is a testament to our qualified staff and grants you outstanding value and peace of mind.Springers Solar was the only Queensland-based founding signatory to the Clean Energy Council (CEC) Approved Solar Retailers Program. We are accredited members of Master Electricians and pride ourselves on our participation in the development and maintenance of quality and safety in the solar industry.A host of testimonials, referrals, qualifications, accreditations, and awards all mean you can rest assured that Springers Solar is the right choice for your home or business."

reviews.review_description: Multiple options clearly explained and well documented.  Great prices.Installation team arrived on time, worked efficiently during an extremely hot day.System setup, configuration, wireless connection completed quickly.Very happy with Springers Solar.

I strongly recommend Springers Solar (South East Qld) if you are thinking about a solar PV system and/or a home battery for a solar PV system. I used them previously (for our former home's Solar PV system) but still did 6 months of research before going with them again for our current home's system. Springers are not the cheapest retailers / installers but are very very good installers and only sell good quality panels/inverters/ batteries, local and use their own installers (no contractors). They have: a 10 year warranty on their installation work;25 operational warranty on Trinia PV panels (30 year power generation guarantee, 87.5 % capacity guaranteed after 30 years); and 10 years on the Tesla Powerwall 3 and Expansion pack (10 year operational warranty and guaranteed 70% retention of battery's original storage capacity at 10 years).Springers have installed 2 systems for me now (previous house and recently current house) and both were top jobs and excellent customer service pre and post installation.Every installer is very busy with the current government panel and battery rebates but Springers are worth the wait.We purchased a 13.5 kWh PV solar panel system (30 x Trina 450W Vertex S+ Dual Glass N-Type Solar panels) and a Tesla 3 Powerwall (13.5 kWh) inverter / battery with an Expansion pack (another 13.5 kWh,  total battery storage of 27 kWh).Great service both pre and post installation and the system is performing as per Springers Solar performanve estimate given with the quote. Only regret is not having bought and installed a second Powerwall Expansion pack to take the battery storage to 40 kWh.Just for clarity / your reassurance:I have no commerical or personal relationship with Springers (paid full price, no discounts or benefits etc for positive reviews or referrals etc).

Install team were great but not provided information from head office which caused a change in design that isn't the best. Battery install was great with the team changing the original design to a practical and workable solution. Only contact from head office is for payment and STC forms.
From the quoting to the installation, the team kept us informed through every step.The installation was neat and the walk-through of the system was detailed and helpful.

We had three similar quotes and whilst the other 2 probably had a more recognisable brand and would have also been a suitable solution we just were impressed by Aiden's response to our questions, he got it, wasn't a sales pitch at all, which gave us a lot of confidence to go with Springers.The installation went smoothly, any small challenge was not too much trouble for them. A really professions and nice bunch of guys.Could not recommend Springers more highly.
Sales quote was well delivered onsite in personInstallation was done in two parts, due to roof painting after bracketsEasy to call and pay
Knowledgeable people with great customer service.Joe was great to deal with and followed through.Very happy with complex roof installation of 20kW system.

I went with Springers because he was the only one to explain the installation setup in the meterbox since we have 2 phase power.  No other installer could explain it in a way I could understand.The install went very quickly, faster than I expected. Was impressed with the crew and supervisor, they obviously knew what they were doing.We are still waiting on the retailer to do the meter replacement which should be this week.
Great sales staff, installers were polite, helpful, tidy and did a really neat install.

Good communications during decision making period, prompt replies to questions, quick scheduling and rescheduling due to change at our end. Installation team was on time, quick, kept us informed during installation and cleaned up after installation. The ducting they installed to carry cabling was very neat and very tidy.
Joe was straight up with an honest approach and no hype. His price was competitive and was able to get installation happning very quickly for us.

5 Stars – Exceptional Service and Expertise!I recently had my solar system upgraded to 16KW by Springers Solar. Springers did my initial 8Kw system in 2023. This time Springers was also installing of a SolarEdge battery with backup, SolarEdge EV charger and SolarEdge hot water controller, with additional 8kW Trina Panels, and I couldn’t be more impressed! From start to finish, the experience was seamless. The sales and quoting process with Joe Springer was clear and straightforward, with no hidden surprises and Joe answered all my random questions without hesitation or bias and was a great listening to all the random ideas and thoughts I had.Prior to the Install, Joe came for a pre-commission site visit. During the visit, he reviewed all locations of installation of items, and at the same time, offered an upgrade to the invertor to the home hub (SolarEdge current offer) however, Springers also upgraded the invertor to 10KW latest home hub invertor as well.The whole installation team was punctual, polite, and tidy, demonstrating exceptional trade skills and service throughout. As a tradesman myself, I was impressed by the professionalism and finish of the electrical installation. Upon completion, the team took the time to explain all components clearly, ensuring I knew how to use set up and use the systems.I’m beyond satisfied with the Springers Solar process and the SolarEdge system, and will opening highly recommend Springers Solar for their professionalism and expertise!

Sales process from initial conversation, to site visits and installation was about couple of months as I have so many questions regarding changes and improvements in technology and legislations as it was upgrade and expansion of existing system with battery!It included upgrade to switchboard, new smart meter, HW timer installation, relocation of batteries, new inverter, 17 new panels and redesign on the go when one could not fit with the group due to being slightly over the roof valley. They were very tidy and punctual and luckily I had some spare roof tiles for replacement as some of them inevitable did brake with amounts of roof traffic.They handled everything on my behalf with Energex and Solar Edge as they agreed to take monitoring and maintenance of older system from previous installers! Last week they come back to replace couple of old optimisers as I've noticed couple of panels underperforming trough Solar Edge monitoring platform, and stoping power production just before new installation!It has been a month and I'm still waiting for the Solar Edge to restore my ability to see panel layout and monitor panel production that I've lost since installation!It has also been couple of months since I've raised the issue of older Powerwall misbehaviour with Tesla and they informed me that they escalated issue to the tier 2 team but it is all running way behind reasonable time due to so many cases and issues in the NE of USA du to numerous storms and weather events over there!???All in all very positive experience with Springers Solar and not so much with Solar Edge and Tesla!

I wanted to keep my business locally on the northside of Brisbane and Springers Solar came through answering all my questions whilst also quoting me on exactly what i wanted and to top it off came back with the best price. They communicated extremely well and were honest with recommendations throughout the whole process also being the only supplier to mention a hot water timer which i can guarantee for only $179 has been a great investment for us.

Sales process was straight forward.  Salesperson was friendly and helpful.Installation was straight forward with no problems. The team commented that they liked the job as it was so easy and straight forward.There were issues with the Fronius software and access to the web which the aftersales service were apologetic and helpful.The grid connection was completed on the day and meter replacement or reassignment was organised.Overall I am happy with the service.
Great communication, able to provide expert advice, installation very clean/tidy/neat. Pleasant and friendly sales and trade staff.

Salesperson was very helpful, knowledgeable, punctual and efficient.  Quote was very good and suited our needs.Installers were punctual, very proficient and professional - working very happily in very hot conditions.  Always very courteous and polite.  Very obvious that they enjoy working with each other and what they do.  All waste was cleaned up afterwards with old system removed and advice given on how to dispose of old lead acid batteries.Customer service was excellent.  Contact both via email and phone was very helpful, professional and understanding.
All I had to do was show them what I wanted and where, after that everything was completed efficiently, cleanly and with respect. Could not fault the entire team.

The quote by Springers solar was easy to understand. Installer arrived promptly and explained the process. Although I thought that there was going to be only removal of old solar panels, the new solar panels also got installed. All connection to the grid was done immediately afterwards. Thanks for help and good customer service.
Fast to respond to a request for a quote.  Easy to deal with and available to answer any questions.  Installation was very smooth with very little intertwined needed from us.

Springers salesperson Dave sent me email and called me right after the quote. He came to my place and explained from 0 to 100 of the solar system and how it can be beneficial for me. He gave the best option and the best price, eve though he could have sold me a more expensive system. After all the were very exact with timing and their great installation team showed up on time and finished the whole job in less than 2 working days. Highly recommended.special thanks to Solarquotes and Mr Peacock for introducing Springers and also his great website.

Springers Solar make for a very happy customer.The sales person was well informed, personable and not at all pushy. He thoroughly explained the whole process and spent a fair while on site answering my questions.The admin people are courteous and promptly answer any queries.The installation team were punctual, tidy and extremely professional. A real credit to themselves and Springers.I thought I would have to pay extra to relocate all the circuit breakers and rewire my switchboard for the backup circuits, but to my pleasant surprise, it was all covered by the quoted scope of works.5 hours after arriving on site, my Tesla battery was charging and I was glued to the app.

My two-phase site is a little bit more complicated than others.  There was an existing 6.6kW system installed (by others) a few years ago.  This work was adding another 5kW of solar, a Tesla battery, and some other minor works.  Of the three quotes, Springers representative documented the scope of works the best.  We had a long discussion about various options and the Springers’ representative was happy to go into the detail.  From my perspective, the install went well on the day.  We had some minor issues post install with the configuration of a Fronius Datamanager, which Springer’s were able to fix.

All in all I requested quotes from 7 providers using SolarQuotes, HiPages and recommendations from my real estate agent and friends. One never came through with anything, two of them called and didn't follow up. I eventually shortlisted 3 providers, and the decision was largely based on how trustworthy, knowledgeable and experienced they were dealing with shading issues, as we are dealing with a large tallow wood tree next door. So I entered into lengthy and detailed discussions around microinverters versus DC optimisers, etc. At the end of the day, the sales rep from Springers made the most competent impression, gave clear advice, and offered a quote that was very competitive.The installation was done professionally and tidy. System performs very well, no issues to report. Very happy with them and would recommend.

Springers were the only company that visited the site before quoting, which also enabled me to ask a lot of ad-hoc questions. Any other queries that came up later via email were handled in a timely manner. Once I agreed to the job, it was over before I knew it. The installation crew were punctual, friendly and got stuck into it on the day with minimal disruption to the household. The meter upgrade was organised and also went ahead with no issues. I'm a happy camper overall.

The sales quoting process was so easy with Springers. Joe (sales person) made sure I understood the system, solar system information and the benefits of the systems that he quoted for. Springers were very responsive to all my questions and provided very helpful and respectful response.The installation was above and beyond what I was expecting. The crew were tidy, helpful, punctual and went out of the way to ensure that my husband and I understood the system installed, how to optimise our usage. I was super impressed with their service and professionalism.The back office staff were super helpful responsive and incredibly professional.Overall this was a really pleasant experience and my husband and I feel reassured that we have a quality system in our house which will reduce our electricity bill. Also we are now better armed with information that means we can get the best out of the energy our system produces.

Did the usual 3 quote process, Springers was better priced for a larger 12.5kw inverter and 15.4kw in panels with known brands. Sales staff didn't talk BS to me and were genuine and honest. Install team were very professional and did a very tidy job working within my requirements without issue. Been averaging 60kwh on sunny winter SE QLD days for last week

The salesman went above and beyond with his service, very rare these days.The installation team were super friendly, kept me in the loop the whole way and did their best, with what turned out to be a tricky installation. Really happy with the service thus far.Too early to tell if I got value for money or give my opinion about the quality of the system.Time will tell the rest, too early to make any predictions at this point but I'm hopefully that the great service will continue.
From quote to completion of the job polite and professional would highly recommend to anyone
Salesman was great and explained everythingCustomer service time is very efficient and friendly
Easy process and quick installation. Nice sales ppl and follow up. Looking forward to first electricity bill.

Springers responded promptly to our inquiry.  They designed the system on site, providing very good advice on what was most suitable for our needs given our available roof space.  The installation was seamless, and the team was friendly and professional.

Salesman was straight to the point and was factual. Didn't was time on a sales pitch.Installation team were high quality and professional. I went with springers primarily cause they had roofers in their team and understood tiled roof installationsFrom start to finish really good cust9mer service.
Very happy with the whole process, very professional and friendly.

A great team of professionals from the quoting process, administration tasks, and the installation process. The installation techs were punctual, respectful, friendly, worked well as a team! Very happy with my new solar system!

We felt the salesman was very honest and not pushy like the other two quotes. He outlines the pros and cons on getting a battery and confirmed the sums didn't add up.  The paperwork was all online, well laid out and easy to understand.  It was simple to sign the contract and pay the deposit.  There is quite a wait for installation but it will hopefully happen on 11 November.

I had what was considered a complex job with ripping out an old (4.6kW) solar and replacing it with 13.2kW panels, SE inverter, battery and backup. But at the same time having my meter box and circuits board relocated and upgraded.Over a day and a half my place was swarmed by army of technicians who worked endlessly in perfect harmony. I'm super impressed with how well organised they were and how clean and flawless (touch wood) it has been since completion.

The sales/quoting process gave us a feeling of confidence in the organisation. As far as the installation process is concerned,we would like to express our appreciation for the excellent work done by the team Springers sent to do our installation. They worked well and cooperated together, and were very kind and courteous in their dealings with us. They are to be congratulated in their choice of employees. We would particularly like to commend the electrician Nate. He had a difficult job and did it with good grace and a lot of self restraint. We give our thanks to all of them for a neat, tidy job, which was all completed in one day in spite of the weather. All was done expeditiously, and paper-work etc. finished with a miminum of fuss and bother to us.
It works, just so hard to integrate.

Service was excellentReally impressed with responsiveness and knowledgeThe team in Lawnton answered all of my complex questions and provided firm guidance.There are a number of great family owned installers on the market with a range of different options and price points but I really feel like I am in safe hands with this team
Excellent sales/ quoting10/10 for Polite , tidy and Punctual10/10 . Give this company 5 stars ??Yes very happy customersExcellent company and very happy with their all around service.

I was very cautious when receiving quotes from solar companies as I had heard of the sea of doggie cheap installs out there with companies dissapearing before the "warranty" runs out leaving customers high and dry.From the first moment Springers solar came to my house to quote my job to the tradespeople coming to complete the install, I have received nothing but competence and friendly staff. I would definitely recommend them to install your solar system.
Very happy with the job done, neat and professional. sales service was top notch
Joe was very professional, informative and honest.We were very comfortable dealing with him.The installers were also professional, clean and took care and pride in their workmanship.

A great experience from start to finish. They answered all my questions before going ahead, communicated very well, and the installation went seamlessly - the team worked very hard, and were very professional and friendly. They also left the place spotless after completing the work. I would definitely recommend Springers.
Provided more than one option. No additional costs after the fact. Generally speaking didn't bad mouth other installers - primarily focused on own products and services.

Getting a quote for my solar PV battery storage system was easy and included a site inspection and discussion of my requirements and available options.My new solar PV and battery storage system has now been operational for several weeks and hasn’t missed a beat and is performing to expectations.  Installation commenced on time, virtually to the minute, and the installation crew were very professional in their undertaking of the work.  I was impressed by the way the crew didn’t take any shortcuts but instead elected to put in the extra effort to ensure the installation work looks good and complied with all technical requirements. The team were most helpful in answering my queries and in helping me to get remote access to the system performance outputs.  From my perspective, Springers Solar is an organization you can be confident will deliver on what is agreed and I would have no hesitation in recommending them to prospective customers.

The sales process and quote was excellent. Out of the 4 companies this was the only one to come and carry out a site visit. Communication was key throughout the process and I was well informed.The installation team were polite, friendly, professional and took an interest in the best installation possible. All though there was a small installation error they were straight onto and rectified immediately.Customer service was great. Connection was all done and across to solar within the next business day after installation.By far the best experience I have had from any trade to date. Highly recommended and very professional and were considerably cheaper than all other quotes.

The Springers Solar team is fantastic to deal with. The initial quote was provided by Dave, from the Lawnton store.He showed me the results from his initial investigation into where we should position the panels, however, after arriving and talking about the shading issues we have during winter we reworked the positioning of the panels and went with a SolarEdge system with optimisers. The quote was received on the same day.After accepting the quote the ball started rolling very quickly, within 1 day I had an installation date booked in, 1 week later. During that time I found and used the 'Pylon Observer' online portal to further tweak the panel layout and sent a tweaked version to Dave to check what his thoughts were.Prior to the day of installed the weather forecast was not looking promising with rain, and lot's of it. However, on the day of the install the installation team (all 6 of them) surprised me and turned up in the morning, as the rain seemed to have go through earlier, and went about installing the system. 5 hours later I have a fully installed and activated system ready to be used.Springers also organised all the forms to have a new smart meter installed, which took 2 weeks to occur.After logging into the SolarEdge user portal I found that I did not have access to the panel level details, which I was told by Dave I would have access to. A quick email to Springers, found that this had happened by accident, since the SolarEdge Genesis inverter with installed, and by default it does not have access to those details. A few hours after contacting Springers the issue was rectified.

Springers Solar provided excellent customer service, recommended options that suited my requirements and met my criteria, provided sound advice, communicated well, offered competitively priced products and delivered exactly as promised. Joe Springer was very approachable and provided all the information I needed and was able to answer the many questions I had. The installation process went well despite the unfavourable wet weather. The staff were punctual, polite and maintained a safe and tidy worksite. Springers Solar have initiated the process of grid connection after the install and I expect to be receiving my feed-in tariff in a couple of weeks. I ended up choosing a more expensive system, but I am very pleased with my choice as the panels (Trina) and inverter (SolarEdge) are recommended brands (by SolarQuotes) and the optimisers will help monitor production and maximise the efficiency of the system.

I had four companies come around to give quotes for the install we wanted. The standard brief to all of them was ‘We want to produce more energy than we need in the house, charge a Tesla Powerwall 2 and also charge an electric car in the future.’Springers were the only ones to actually listen and think outside the standard install. After a few emails and phone call back and forwards, we got them on the job.They chose a 3 phase upgrade to the house, 3 inverters with a total of 19.44kW of panels, Powerwall 2 and a rethink of the layout compared to the old system being removed.What we got is absolutely spot on to the brief.The pre install info was great, the install team were here all week as it was a large install and we’re great to deal with. The team really listened to our wishes of a clean, tidy and great looking install for the inverters, Tesla Gateway and Powerwall 2. It’s a sight to behold and a real feature of the house now.Inside the house, they redid the electrical circuit breaker panel which was a dogs breakfast. Now it’s neat, tidy and looks as you would think it should. It really was bad before they came. Years of upgrades and no one with an eye for detail.After they left and the system was online, the power we generate is way more than the online calculations.To say we are happy is an understatement.Thank you Springers Solar!  You are a breath of fresh air.No more power from the grid for us.

Springers provided clear advice tailored to my circumstances, enabling me to make an informed choice. The installation team communicated well and carried out the work efficiently. Connection to the grid followed smoothly.

From start to finish I'd like to say that this company is absolutely fantastic.  Big thanks to Dave, Thilanka, Jonty and the guys who came to do the installation yesterday and today.  The most friendly, polite, respectful, bunch of guys.  I was kept up-to-date every step of the way during the installation. Thanks again Rose Manuel.

Very professional from the get go. The salesman was happy to discuss different options for our needs. The office staff were always professional and easy to correspond/speak with.  They have their own installers who arrived on time and were very efficient with the install.  Very polite and tidy. They helped with explaining the app and grid connection process too.  Very very happy we chose a local company to support.  5 stars.

Springers Solar was the only one of three to actually come out to the house. The other two quoted over the phone using satallite image. Sales person spent considerable time explaining options and choices of products. Did not over sell expensive optional extas, but did give us a reason to g with some of the options, like active monitoring which, while not essential to the performance, was something I was interested in. One competitor was really pushing the cheaper products as being just as good. One was targetting  a reasonable quality but basic package and did not take the time to assess that I was intersted in some of the options. Eventually they offered some additional products, but different brands, whereas the Springers offer was integrated products from SolarEdge.Installation was on time, professional, friendly, tidy.  It looks good.  Installation was interrupted by rain and they came back within a few days to finish the job.
Sales and quoting process was great. I am really impressed with the Solar Edge software. Technicians were punctual and very helpful, tidy and respectful.

After the initial contact, the sales man, came over and gave me a detailed quote with all the possible options for solar panels and inverters.The company was very competivie on price and went the extra mile to help me install a new meter box.The installing team, especially the electrians had a lot of experience and knowledge about what they were doing. They even explain to a lay person about what the  residual device unit does. They also threw in a timer unit for the hotwater system in for free.I would highly recommend them to anyone.

Not surprisingly, whilst installing Solar is a 'no brainer' when you live in Queensland, the mass confusion surrounding options and costs is overwhelming and tends to result in procrastination.Solarquotes changed that position by simplifying the process, providing clarity, and instilling a 'previously absent' level of confidence ( Nice work Finn and team )Of the three quotes sought 'Springers Solar' was the only one to tick all of the box's.I'd never heard of 'Springers Solar' up until that point.But i'm glad i do now, what an amazing customer experience.After an hour long, no pressure, relaxed site visit (where all of my questions were fully answered and many options explored) a plan was drawn up that met all of my specific needs.We weren't interested in 'cheap and cheerful', 'quality and reliability' were the prime considerations.So, after some consideration and with some trepidation, we bit the bullet and signed the contract.And it didn't disappoint, it just got better.'Under promise and over deliver' must be the company mantra.* During the sales / quotation period communication was in writing, clear and simple to follow.* Installation took place well within the expected time frame.* The installation team were 'professionals' in every respect. They were on-time, looked the part, were well equipped and knowledgeable, polite and respectful. Clean and tidy at every stage.* Photos of the install were provided and a simple overview on the basics conducted.* Post installation they seamlessly arranged the required meter box up-grade and grid connection in addition to providing all of the required certificates etcAre we happy with the result ? You bet.Did we get what we paid for ? Absolutely.Would we recommend Springers Solar to family and friends? In a heart beat.Are we saving what we expected ?  Exceeding expectation in first two monthsNice work Joe and teamPS  A special shout out to to office / admin team - exceptional customer service

The sales quoting process was informative and comforting, there was no question that could not be answered, after checking online we felt comfortable in knowing that we had the truth and not lead by a huge sale pitch that pleasured us into a corner. The quote was tailored to our needs, it was fair, affordable and detailed.The installation was very professional, the four young men who  arrived when they said they would despite the distance travelled they looked after us very well, they were gentlemen who knew their profession well and communicated with us through the process explaining what was happening. They were kind and caring being sure not to damage our property. The detail was amazing, right down to cleaning the wall around the inverter before they left.After the installation we were walked through the process and given a hands on look at how the system worked and how to read energy levels. Within half an hour we was connected via email to the system online.We recommend this fully Australian owned family business to anyone who in the market for good old Aus honesty, no fuss, value for your buck when it comes to solar energy.
Maddy was very friendly and courteous communicating the schedule!Installation team were polite, understanding, efficient and cleaned up after themselves!

Springers Sales Consultant, Dave W. demonstrated excellent knowledge & understanding, acted with 'old school integrity' & advised on the best product & design for maximum energy production. His professionalism gained my trust at our first meeting.  The installation crew were highly efficient, enthusiastic & punctual.  ***** Service & Administration Manager,  Sharmyn's seamless communication kept me informed for the entire journey.An exciting new chapter in our lives.  Thank you Springers Solar Team
reviews.battery_brand: None yet!  as we are waiting for the price to drop in future. (Other)

reviews.review_description: From sales to installation cant complain.Happy with the price, were't the cheapest but you only get what you pay for.I told them I was very fussy and I didn't have any problems at all. All the guys and girl were very polite and efficient, and got on without any problems.They finished in less than a day. They Cleaned every thing up and took it all the rubbish   away. Can highly recommend them.Troy set  every thing upon the computer for me to save me the hassle.Thanks to all the team.  Mike

The whole process was very smooth and efficient.From initial contact, John, the local manager, was quick to act, was very helpful and not "pushy",  and responded to all queries promptly.The installation took place on the day specified and again went smoothly and all very clean and tidy.Some minor queries regarding the installation were again dealt with promptly and satisfactorily.While not the cheapest, we believe it was good value for money, with excellent customer service

I like the fact that they do everything frome sales to instalation and electrical work needed all trades are in-house. Clearly to give a accurate quote an inspection is required and there response was excellent the quote was professional providing a detail description of requirements and what was to be delivered.
Very nice to deal with, got a Sunnyboy and they came back to help me connect to the web properly,

From the initial contact by David Whinnett (he turned up exactly on time) to review our needs, answer our many questions and provide a quote. to the installers (who turned up on time as well!), we felt like we were dealing with a group of true professionals.There were no pressure tactics to sign a contract with Springers, only quiet confidence that this mob knew what they were on about.We have known about Springers since we arrived in the area 30+ years ago, their longevity is a testament to their professionalism and high customer service standard, so agreeing to use them for our solar installation was the definite way to go.We have not been disappointed, the system installed working perfectly and, with the additional smart meter we purchased, we can review, at any time, the performance of the solar panels against our ongoing usage.Would highly recommend Springers for solar needs.
Installation is occurring as I write this email.

Springers Solar have recently supplied and installed a Tesla Powerwall 2 to my existing solar system. I received quotes from three suppliers of varying equipment and specification. Two of the suppliers were unable to supply Tesla Powerwall 2, as they were unavailable and actually stated nobody had them in stock. They also stated that the Tesla unit was more expensive than their proposed packages.Springers Solar had available stock and their price was actually lower than the other two quotes (Springers Solar also committed to possibly lowering their price once they had a site inspection). Eddie Springer visited my house to inspect the site. He was straight forward and easy to deal with and as committed, he was able to offer a better price. He also delivered his confidence in their workmanship and committed to keeping all wiring concealed where possible. One of the main reasons I chose the Tesla Powerwall 2 was the neat integration of the whole package.The installers arrived on-time on the install date and they worked efficiently and neatly. Paul and the other two guys did a great job of the installation and they did in fact conceal all wiring as committed. Paul's knowledge of the Tesla Product was evident and he had the system operating which he was able to demonstrate with the Tesla app very quickly. They even took time to clean up once they were finished.The only issue I had with the entire process was that the Tesla Powerwall 2 had some slight paint damage on the outer housing, which evidently happened in transit. Initially, Springers offered to repair the damage which I was fine with, as it was minimal. After a couple of weeks they phoned me to say that they would actually swap my unit for a brand new one. I was surprised and pleased.Springers Solar exceeded my expectation at every level. The entire process from admin to install was very efficient and easy.I'd have no hesitation in recommending them based on my experience.

We only sought 2 Quotes through Solar Quotes because we had already contacted Springers whom we had met at a Caravan Expo and we were waiting for them to visit to quote.Later, I did notice Springers are on your list, and rightly so as so far we have been impressed with them even though a delay in install. [ Christmas hols, I guess ]Of the 2 quotes you gave us, we only heard from one.  We found them very helpful and they put together an impressive QuoteIn a way we were sorry we could not go with them, particularly as they would have installed prior to Christmas.Springers won out in the end at slightly less dollars and the better inverter system - 21 x Enphase mini - V  Solar EdgeWe have found your site to be very useful and educational and do thank youKevin

Being late to the solar game, we decided to go for a higher end solar/hybrid system - LG Neon2 panels, Enphase microinverters, and a Tesla Powerwall 2 battery.Springers patiently answered all our questions, and provided us with a number of options - all viable and with different costs, although we went the whole hog with 4.6 kW of the best panels, and AC microinverters with the Tesla battery.Quoted delivery and installation times were reasonable, although a late schedule change on another job meant they were able to install the whole system after only a couple of weeks, well ahead of the original time quoted. The installation team were quick, neat and efficient, and Paul who did the final electrical connections took the time to explain everything to us (as well as tidying up our switchboard).The final installation is super neat, and we have the whole house backed up with the battery (we have avoided 5 power outages in our first 3 months, not to mention possible power spikes). We chose the more expensive set-up, but are glad we did - even cloudy and rainy days have not required grid power. 3 months of self-powering, and we wouldn't hesitate to recommend Springers Solar to anyone. We had considered to get a solar system with batteries for our house (which is three phase) for a long time and dealt with a number of companies - only to find that many of them are pure salesmen with little actual technical knowledge and struggle with anything that is off the beaten track.Springers were very different: I got to deal with people that were able to answer all my questions and if they did not know an answer right away were open enough to say so (instead of giving you some BS story) and came back with the right information a day or so later. - And I had many questions, so I really appreciated the patience and diligence they showed in this process.By the time it came to buy the system I did of course get other quotes (for the exact same system) only to find that all of the others were more expensive.Installation day was quite an event: Since we went for a larger system a whole army directed by two members of the Springer family arrived so that all the work on the roof got done on the day - the commissioning of the batteries and the overall system was done the next day.And I have to commend the whole team: As my wife said, all of them were friendly, courteous and very respectful of our property - and every little bit was cleaned up before they left.All in all we are extremely satisfied with the whole process and the result we got !

Regarding the three supplier names sent to me by SolarQuotes:#1 was clearly interested in selling me a microinverter system, which I was willing to consider. His opening spiel when I rang him was along the lines of "Well, you've gotta get smart about where your panels are sited..." So he sent me a proposed panel array for my property in which all panels were to go on the WSW facing roof, which is subject to almost complete afternoon shading from trees, whereas the ENE-facing roof is not shaded at all, morning or afternoon. Somehow that didn't seem so smart to me, so I didn't follow up with this guy.#2 gave me a competitive price for Fronius + SunPower panels. Flashy website, more pics than info, but otherwise would have been in the game for me.#3 gave me an initial quote that was well above others for Fronius + SunPower. When queried about this, they immediately revised their quote down to - guess what? - pretty well exactly what other players were quoting. My take on this: initial quote was an ambit proposal, made to cover the possibility that I might be an ill-informed idiot, dreamily numbed into submission by their slick, expensive-looking website. On being disabused of that notion, Plan B kicks in. which is to provide a competitive quote.
